subject.title: [Feedback] MuMuClaw积分退还请求 - AI桌面操控任务未完成

question: Should this refund request be split from the paired technical report and routed to MuMuClaw billing/support?
rationale: OpenClaw source cannot issue credits, but repository policy requires explicit handling before closing only one half of a same-author paired incident.

options.title: Split and route billing
options.body: Send the credit request to MuMuClaw support and keep only an evidence-backed technical report in OpenClaw.

options.title: Keep paired temporarily
options.body: Leave both items open until the external platform owner confirms the incident-routing process.

recommendation.title: Split and route billing
recommendation.body: Send the credit request to MuMuClaw support and keep only an evidence-backed technical report in OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the approval and node-control surfaces that define the repository-side boundary.
